panels.title: Kubernetes only Ready and unready pods
panels.description: Question: How many pods are ready or explicitly unready? Units: pods. Data source: Prometheus kube-state-metrics. Expected delay: 15â€“45 seconds. Next: inspect pod phase and container waiting reasons. Local Compose has no Kubernetes data; no data is unknown.

panels.title: Kubernetes only Pod phase, readiness and restarts

targets.expr: max by (namespace,pod,phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace",environment=~"$environment",pod=~"$pod",phase="Pending"}) or max by (namespace,pod,phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace",environment=~"$environment",pod=~"$pod",phase="Failed"}) or max by (namespace,pod,phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{namespace=~"$namespace",environment=~"$environment",pod=~"$pod",phase="Running"})

(max by (namespace,pod,owner_name) (kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",environment=~"$environment",owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}) * on (namespace,owner_name) group_left (deployment) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace,replicaset,owner_name) (kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"$namespace",environment=~"$environment",owner_kind="Deployment"}), "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"), "owner_name", "$1", "replicaset", "(.+)")) and on (namespace,deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace",environment=~"$environment",deployment=~"$workload"} >= 0)

panels.description: Question: Which pods are pending/failed, ready/unready, restarting, waiting, or recently terminated, and which service label owns them? Units: phase/readiness/reason state and cumulative restarts. Data source: Prometheus kube-state-metrics. Expected delay: 15â€“45 seconds. Next: inspect pod logs and cluster events. Restart count alone does not mean a crash. Local Compose has no Kubernetes data; no data is unknown.

panels.title: Kubernetes only â€” Restart increases (OOM evidence when reported)
panels.description: Question: Are container restart counters increasing, and is last termination reported as OOMKilled? Units: restarts in range and boolean reason. Data source: Prometheus kube-state-metrics. Expected delay: 15â€“45 seconds. Next: correlate the restart with logs and resource history. A restart is not automatically a crash. Local Compose has no Kubernetes data; no data is unknown.

panels.title: Kubernetes only Job and CronJob state
panels.description: Question: Are batch jobs active, completed, failed, and are CronJobs suspended or overdue for their next schedule? Units: job counts / suspension state / Unix timestamp. Data source: Prometheus kube-state-metrics. Expected delay: 15â€“45 seconds. Next: inspect the Job pod logs and CronJob schedule. Completed Jobs are not treated as unhealthy long-running services. Local Compose has no Kubernetes data; no data is unknown.

panels.title: Kubernetes only Collected pod stdout/stderr
panels.description: Question: What did the selected namespace, workload, pod, and service write to stdout/stderr, filtered by severity? Units: log events. Data source: Loki via node-level Collector filelog receiver. Expected delay: usually under 30 seconds. Next: inspect the container's previous termination reason, readiness probe, and related traces. Deployment logs carry namespace, pod, container, workload, service, and environment labels; Jobs may not have a deployment label. Local Compose has no Kubernetes pod logs; no data is unknown.

panels.title: Kubernetes only Events are not collected

options.content: This chart does not configure a Kubernetes Events source. Inspect recent scheduling, probe, and backoff events with `kubectl describe pod`. Events are not inferred from pod logs. Local Compose has no Kubernetes Events.
